translation.name: Lock picks
profile: Lock picks are specialized tools for opening locks. In Elaria, they may be carried by a scout, locksmith, guard's assistant, or someone with less honest intentions. Ownership alone does not define a hero's character. A case bearing a workshop's emblem may help trace the maker or a former owner if the set is found in an abandoned residence.

They add a bonus to the relevant agility test but do not guarantee success. The hero needs access to the lock and must describe an actual attempt. They do not automatically remove a trap, curse, or magical protection on a door. The party can instead search for a key, the owner, or authorized access; the tool expands their options without forcing a single solution.

Rules effect: +2 AGI to a lock-opening test. The price is 2 gp. The item is reusable rather than a single-use supply. Its listed effect applies to the situation it is intended for. Additional bonuses, other forms of protection, and new magical abilities are not part of this entry.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
This item's effects, requirements, and price.
strings.Lze použít i jako vrhací zbraň: Can also be used as a thrown weapon
strings.+2 O při lezení nebo překonávání překážk: +2 AGI when climbing or overcoming an obstacle, if the rope can be used meaningfully
strings.Poskytuje světlo v okolí: Provides light in the surrounding area
strings.Umožňuje běžně rozdělat oheň: Allows an ordinary fire to be lit
